```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

```{r}
urodzenia <- read_xlsx(path = "dane/pl_uro_2025_00_7.xlsx", 
          sheet = "Ogółem",
          range = "C11:N41",
          col_names = paste0("m_", 1:12),
          na = "-") %>% 
  mutate(dzien = row_number()) %>% 
  select(dzien, everything()) %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("m"), 
               names_to = "miesiac",
               names_pattern = "m_(.+)",
               values_to = "ile") %>% 
  mutate(miesiac = month(as.integer(miesiac), label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE), 
         dzien = factor(dzien)) %>%
  arrange(miesiac, dzien) %>% 
  #filter(!is.na(ile))
  drop_na(ile)

urodzenia
```

```{r}
month(11, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE)
```

```{r}
urodzenia %>%
  ggplot(aes(miesiac, dzien)) + 
  geom_tile(aes(fill = ile)) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red", midpoint = 600) +  
  theme_minimal()
```
